idle_1200.requirement: idle share of all residents at 12:00 median <= 0.60 (spring-autumn)

Y2_deaths_dehydration_10.requirement: zero in every seed at day 10

Y2_deaths_starvation_10.requirement: zero in every seed at day 10

Y3_alive_band.requirement: alive in [32, 44] at every day sample from day 30

Y3_birth_by_day4.requirement: a birth by day 4 in every seed (10-day round)

Y3_old_age_by_day30.requirement: >= 1 old-age death by day 30 in every seed

Y3_one_settlement.requirement: one settlement at every day sample

Y3_replacement.requirement: births >= deaths - 3 over days 30..120 in every seed

Y3_stagnation.requirement: longest stagnant run <= 4 days in every seed

first_night_spread.requirement: among seed-winters with a dark night: first one on >= 3 distinct nights, <= 0.70 on the seventh

no_dark_night.requirement: share of seed-winters with no dark night in [0.15, 0.60]

severity_shares.requirement: each severity's share of the seed-winters within +-0.10 of its weight

two_or_more.requirement: share of seed-winters with >= 2 dark nights in [0.10, 0.50]

normal_gathered.requirement: median winter wood gathered over normal-severity seed-winters >= 0.9 x v12's median

retarget_share.requirement: winter wood_retargets / winter wood trips, median over seed-winters <= 0.10

Y12_day10.requirement: no gatherer with hunger or thirst >= 90 at any 120-tick sample

Y12_day120.requirement: no gatherer with hunger or thirst >= 90 at any 120-tick sample

Y4_every_seed.requirement: each seed's store share from day 3 >= 0.40

Y4_store_share.requirement: store meals / all meals per seed-day from day 3, median >= 0.60

Y5_autumn_wood.requirement: autumn wood gathered per day median >= 1.5 x summer's (seed-days)

Y5_autumn_work.requirement: autumn adult work share at 12:00 median >= v11's autumn value - 0.05

Y6_trip_days.requirement: days with wood trips per winter (of 7), median over seed-winters >= 4

Y6_trips.requirement: wood trips per winter, median over seed-winters >= 20

Y7_other_lit.requirement: outside winter, 02:00 lit share: median >= 0.95, every seed >= 0.85

Y7_winter_lit.requirement: per seed share of winter nights lit at 02:00: median in [0.70, 0.97], every seed >= 0.50

Y8_winter_cold.requirement: winter cold members / members in the cold window: median <= 0.25, every seed <= 0.50

Y8_winter_food.requirement: food store at each winter's last periodic sample, median >= 0.8 x v11's

receipt.requirement: 8.5 tests pass and check_z6.py verdicts all PASS (or applied 0, listed)
9.4 byte identity, loader round-trip, every meta field documented

day10.requirement: median ms/agent-tick <= 1.2 x same-host game_v12, recorder off

day120.requirement: median ms/agent-tick <= 1.2 x same-host game_v12, recorder off

recorder.requirement: the recorder's wall time per 120-day episode reported
